track.title: Gusheh-e Moshtarak 28: Majles-afruz
track.notes: A gushe shared by several dastgah-ha (gusheh-ye moshtarak); the album does not say which dastgah it is played in here. In his radif albums Alizadeh plays Majles-afruz in Mahur, Shur. Its tonic is its own voted finalis.

progression.narrative: The performance opens on E4 and dwells most on E in Majles-afruz. The line peaks at E4 (333.0 Hz) at 0:20.8. It closes on D4, not the tonic (D4 → D4 → D4 → D4 → D4 → D4).
